objects.name: chapter_act
objects.description: What a chapter's leadership did, in the chapter's own record. This domain calls a structure a chapter; the module does not know the word.

objects.name: custody_event
objects.description: The organization's audit trail of everything done to member data as data.

objects.name: export_job
objects.description: An export build: the HQ register, or one member's own data under a subject access request.

objects.name: contact_read
objects.description: An operator viewing a member's phone number, which spends a capability and is shown back to the member.

objects.name: consent_text_version
objects.description: One rendering of the membership consent sheet, in English, Swahili or Luo.

objects.name: consent_record
objects.description: A member's acceptance of the consent sheet, stamped at the chapter they were registered in.
